proof:
change ∀ (m : ℕ) (a b : Fin m → ℤ) (i fuel : ℕ), (M7.ObjectiveComparison.lexFrom a b i fuel).2 ≤ 2 * fuel
intro m a b i fuel
induction fuel generalizing i with
| zero => simp [M7.ObjectiveComparison.lexFrom]
| succ fuel ih =>
    have h := ih (i + 1)
    simp only [M7.ObjectiveComparison.lexFrom]
    repeat' split
    all_goals
      dsimp only at *
      omega
